# Sprint Planning

## Overview
This wiki page details the Sprint 15 planning session for [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md), held on July 10, 2026. The team aligned on sprint goals, committed deliverables, stretch goals, carried-over tasks, and parking lot items.

## Key Details
- **Sprint Goal**: Stabilize an 8-node mesh and publish the [power budget](./power-budget.md).
- **Committed Items**:
  - **[Mira](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md)**: Rejoin spike profiling on the nRF5340 evaluation board.
  - **Jonah**: Comparison page update versus the [SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md).
  - **Intern**: Fix the forum scrape CSS selector.
- **Stretch Goals**:
  - [MQTT export](./mqtt-export.md) CSV sample.
  - OTA update design document (design only, no implementation).
- **Carried-Over Tasks**:
  - Contradiction linter for battery claims.
  - `index.md` refresh ahead of the upcoming investor demo.
- **Parking Lot**:
  - [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md) co-[marketing](./marketing.md) (to be revisited in August).
  - Rename [MeshSync](./meshsync.md) to MeshSink (rejected for the 5th time).
